definition.comparison: Exact saved-value inequality after lossless conversion to float64; no tolerance, threshold, norm or gradient
definition.cumulative_anchor: The same immutable untrained initialization for every stage
definition.denominator: All individual parameters in all 88 hidden matrices, including unchanged entries and zero-displacement matrices
definition.numerator: Number of individual hidden-matrix parameters whose saved values differ from the declared anchor
definition.old_proxy: Parameter mass of matrices having any nonzero displacement; not the fraction of individual parameters changed
definition.saved_segment_anchor: Initialization at the first retained stage, otherwise the immediately preceding retained checkpoint
